query: Run /blueprint revise. A legacy integration must remain for six months because its replacement is not ready. It violates the preferred dependency direction. Record a safe exception without pretending the current system already matches the target.
expected_behavior: Preserves the legacy integration as an explicit transition state instead of demanding immediate removal
Records the exception with scope, rationale, owner, risk, compensating controls, review trigger, and removal condition
Keeps the exception proposed until the declared human approval role explicitly accepts it and records that approval evidence
Keeps the stable principle unchanged unless evidence shows the principle itself is wrong
Shows the allowed dependency only on the current or transition map, not as part of the target architecture
Defines evidence that will close or extend the exception
Avoids using an arbitrary deadline as the sole removal mechanism
